product_summary: An AI-powered platform designed to help users identify high-performing LinkedIn content, analyze its engagement drivers, and generate new, optimized posts that mimic successful trends for increased reach and interaction.
problem_statement: Content creators and marketers on LinkedIn struggle to consistently produce highly engaging posts due to the dynamic nature of trends, the difficulty in manually analyzing successful content, and the time-consuming process of crafting new, optimized posts. This leads to suboptimal content performance and missed opportunities for audience growth.
target_users: Individual Professionals (e.g., thought leaders, job seekers)
Agencies managing multiple client LinkedIn profiles
success_metrics: Average engagement rate (likes, comments, shares per impression) of AI-generated posts compared to user-generated baseline.
Number of trending posts identified per day/week.
User satisfaction with generated post quality (e.g., via feedback mechanism).
Reduction in time spent by users on content research and creation.
Number of active users and generated posts.

features.name: Trending Post Discovery
features.description: Allows users to discover LinkedIn posts that are currently gaining significant traction based on predefined or user-adjustable criteria.
acceptance_criteria: System displays a list of trending posts.
Users can filter trending posts by keywords, hashtags, or broad topics.
Trending posts are updated at least hourly.
Each trending post entry includes basic information (author, snippet, link, primary engagement metrics).

features.name: Detailed Engagement Analysis
features.description: Provides a breakdown of engagement metrics for a selected trending post, potentially highlighting factors contributing to its success.
acceptance_criteria: Upon selecting a post, the system displays total likes, comments, shares, and potentially views.
System provides a simple summary of why the post is trending (e.g., 'high comment velocity').
Users can view the full content of the selected post.

features.name: AI-Powered Post Generation
features.description: Generates a new LinkedIn post that is 'similar' in style, topic, or theme to a selected high-engagement post, but optimized for maximum engagement.
acceptance_criteria: Users can select a trending post and initiate generation of a new post.
The generated post is relevant to the original post's topic/theme.
The generated post incorporates elements identified as high-engagement drivers (e.g., questions, calls to action, specific formatting).
Users can copy the generated post text.
Generated posts are grammatically correct and coherent.

features.name: User Authentication & Profile Management
features.description: Secure user login, registration, and basic profile management.
acceptance_criteria: Users can register and log in securely.
Users can manage their basic profile information (e.g., email, password).

features.name: Search & Filter Enhancements
features.description: Advanced filtering options for trending posts (e.g., by industry, company size, specific influencers, post type).
acceptance_criteria: Users can apply multiple filters simultaneously.
Search results are refined based on applied filters.

features.name: Engagement Driver Insights
features.description: More sophisticated analysis identifying specific keywords, sentiment, content structure, or media types that contribute to high engagement.
acceptance_criteria: System provides a list of 'engagement drivers' (e.g., 'use of emojis', 'asking questions', 'personal story').
Insights are actionable and explainable.

features.name: Post Generation Customization
features.description: Allows users to provide additional prompts or modify parameters for the AI during post generation (e.g., tone, length, specific keywords to include/exclude).
acceptance_criteria: Users can input specific keywords or phrases for the AI to incorporate.
Users can select a desired tone (e.g., professional, casual, inspiring).
Users can specify desired post length.

user_flows.name: Discover Trending Posts
steps: System displays a dashboard with currently trending LinkedIn posts.
User can optionally apply filters (e.g., keywords, topics).
User reviews the list of trending posts.

user_flows.name: Analyze a Specific Trending Post
steps: User is viewing the list of trending posts.
User clicks on a specific post to view details.
System displays the full post content and its detailed engagement metrics.
System provides a summary of engagement drivers (MVP: basic; Post-MVP: advanced).

user_flows.name: Generate a New High-Engagement Post
steps: User is viewing the detailed analysis of a trending post.
(Post-MVP: User can provide additional prompts or customization).
System processes the request and generates a new post.
User can copy the generated post text.

modules.name: User Management Service
modules.responsibility: Handles user registration, authentication, authorization, and profile management.

modules.name: LinkedIn Data Ingestion Service
modules.responsibility: Connects to LinkedIn (via API or controlled scraping), fetches raw post data, and stores it. Handles rate limits and data freshness.

modules.name: Trending Algorithm Service
modules.responsibility: Processes raw LinkedIn post data to identify and rank 'trending' posts based on various metrics (e.g., engagement velocity, total engagement, recency).

modules.name: Engagement Analysis Service
modules.responsibility: Extracts and quantifies engagement metrics from posts. Analyzes content to identify potential drivers of engagement (e.g., keywords, sentiment, structure).

modules.name: Content Generation Service (AI Core)
modules.responsibility: Utilizes an AI model (e.g., LLM) to generate new post content based on input from the Engagement Analysis Service and user preferences.

modules.name: API Gateway / Frontend Service
modules.responsibility: Acts as the primary interface for the frontend application. Orchestrates calls to backend services, handles request/response formatting, and potentially caching.

suggested_tech_stack: Backend: Python (Flask/FastAPI) for AI/ML, Node.js/Java for other microservices
Database: PostgreSQL (relational), potentially MongoDB (NoSQL for raw data)
AI/ML: Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI API (or similar LLM provider), Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow
expected_scale: Initial Launch: 1,000 daily active users (DAU), 10,000 trending posts processed daily, 500 generated posts daily. Year 1: 10,000 DAU, 100,000 trending posts processed daily, 5,000 generated posts daily. Peak Load: Ability to handle bursts of 2-3x average load for short periods.

data_entities.name: User
data_entities.description: Stores information about registered users of the platform.

data_entities.name: LinkedInPost
data_entities.description: Stores raw and processed data for LinkedIn posts identified as trending or analyzed.

data_entities.name: EngagementMetric
data_entities.description: Stores historical and current engagement metrics for a specific LinkedIn post.

data_entities.name: GeneratedPost
data_entities.description: Stores the content of posts generated by the AI for users.

data_entities.name: SearchQuery
data_entities.description: Stores user-defined search criteria for trending posts.

possible_apis.description: Authenticates a user and returns an access token.
Retrieves a list of currently trending LinkedIn posts. Supports optional query parameters for filtering (e.g., ?keywords=AI&limit=10).
Retrieves detailed information and engagement metrics for a specific LinkedIn post.
Generates a new LinkedIn post similar to the specified post_id, optimized for engagement.
Retrieves a list of posts previously generated by the AI for the authenticated user.

functional_requirements: FR1: The system shall allow users to register and log in securely.
FR2: The system shall display a dashboard of trending LinkedIn posts.
FR3: The system shall allow users to filter trending posts by keywords and hashtags.
FR4: The system shall provide detailed engagement metrics (likes, comments, shares, views) for any selected trending post.
FR5: The system shall generate a new LinkedIn post based on a selected trending post, maintaining thematic similarity while optimizing for engagement.
FR6: The generated post shall be presented to the user for review and copying.
FR7: The system shall store generated posts for user's historical reference.
FR8: The system shall ensure data displayed for trending posts is fresh, updated at least hourly.

non_functional_requirements.description: Trending post discovery should be fast. Post generation should be responsive.
non_functional_requirements.target_metric: Trending posts list loads within 3 seconds. Post detail view loads within 2 seconds. Post generation completes within 10 seconds.

non_functional_requirements.description: The system must be able to handle an increasing number of users and data volume without significant performance degradation.
non_functional_requirements.target_metric: Support 10,000 DAU and process 100,000 posts daily.

non_functional_requirements.description: The system should be highly available and resilient to failures.
User data and access to LinkedIn data must be protected.
non_functional_requirements.target_metric: Adherence to industry best practices for authentication, authorization, and data encryption (at rest and in transit).

non_functional_requirements.description: Information about trending posts must be current.
The codebase should be modular, well-documented, and easy to update and extend.
non_functional_requirements.target_metric: Low technical debt, clear module boundaries.

constraints: Reliance on LinkedIn's API terms of service and rate limits (if using API).
Legal and ethical considerations regarding data scraping if API access is insufficient or restricted.
Computational cost associated with running and fine-tuning large language models for content generation.
The quality of generated content is dependent on the underlying AI model's capabilities and training data.
The system must comply with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) for user data.
assumptions: We can obtain sufficient access to LinkedIn post data (either via official API or legally permissible and technically feasible scraping).
'Trending' can be effectively defined and identified algorithmically based on available engagement metrics.
AI models (LLMs) are capable of generating coherent, relevant, and engaging LinkedIn post content based on provided examples and optimization goals.
Users will have a basic understanding of how to use an AI content generation tool.
The system will primarily focus on text-based posts, with potential future expansion to include image/video analysis.
open_questions: What is the exact definition and calculation for 'trending' posts? (e.g., engagement velocity, absolute numbers, specific time windows, specific types of engagement).
What are the specific legal and technical implications of accessing LinkedIn data? Will an official API be sufficient, or will scraping be necessary, and if so, how will legal compliance be ensured?
What level of customization will be offered for AI-generated posts in the MVP vs. future iterations?
How will the system handle different languages for trending post discovery and generation? (MVP will likely be English-only).
What are the specific performance targets for the AI content generation (e.g., latency, cost per generation)?
How will the system measure the 'similarity' between a generated post and a source post?
Will the system need to detect and filter out spam or low-quality trending posts?
out_of_scope: Direct integration for posting content to LinkedIn from the platform.
Advanced analytics dashboards for user's own LinkedIn performance.
Support for multiple social media platforms beyond LinkedIn.
